verdict.rationale: There is no llms.txt or .md docs endpoint: the probes returned 404 for learn.microsoft.com/llms.txt and the .md variant. Agent-oriented access to the docs does exist through two routes: an official MCP server documented on Microsoft Learn, and the raw Markdown source of the Entra docs in the public MicrosoftDocs/entra-docs GitHub repo, both of which an agent can consume. Missing for 10: a published llms.txt, Markdown versions served from the docs site, Entra-specific agent-oriented doc guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of agents using the MCP server or raw docs.
